name: What are the signs I need to replace my tankless water heater?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs I need to replace my tankless water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate a tankless water heater replacement may be necessary include inconsistent water temperature, reduced hot water flow, frequent error codes, or visible leaks. A significant increase in repair frequency or cost also suggests it might be more economical to replace the unit. Our technicians can assess your unit's performance and provide a professional recommendation based on its age and condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inconsistent water temperature, reduced flow, frequent error codes, or leaks are signs you may need a tankless water heater replacement.
